defects.refresh window units: refreshToken compares seconds since expiry with REFRESH_WINDOW_MS, which config.js defines in milliseconds, so tokens expired up to about 19 years ago are refreshed instead of 7 days.
defects.invited members admitted: findMembership in db.js does not filter on status, so requireMember admits a user whose membership is still 'invited' (the seeded p1/u3 row), though the spec requires an active membership.
defects.members route unguarded: app.js mounts memberRoutes before projectRoutes, so the router.param membership guard never runs for PATCH /projects/:projectId/members/:userId, letting any signed-in user change roles in any project.
defects.list IDOR: GET /projects reads userId from req.query before req.user.id, so any signed-in user can list another user's memberships.
defects.protocol-relative redirect: safeNextPath only checks startsWith('/'), so next=//evil.com passes and login redirects the browser to another site.

decoys.decoy readBearer prefix: readBearer now returns the raw Authorization header when the Bearer prefix is missing, so a Basic credential reaches verifyToken.
decoys.decoy spread drops algorithms: Spreading VERIFY_OPTIONS into REFRESH_VERIFY_OPTIONS drops the algorithms pin, so refreshToken accepts alg none tokens.
decoys.decoy signFor algorithm: signFor no longer passes the HS256 algorithm, so refreshed and issued tokens are sent unsigned.
